description.value: The Well Liquor Store is a liquor retail shop located in Nanaimo, BC, in what appears to be a unit within a commercial complex (unit 1 per OSM). As a local liquor store, it offers a convenient stop for touring cyclists looking to pick up beverages along their route through the Nanaimo area.
